TypeLeast：按一下，说话。再按一下，文字写到光标处。

## 本次更新 / What is new

<!-- typeleast-update:zh -->
- Mac：fn 只听写，⌥Space 进入提示词模式。
- Mac：选中文字再按 ⌥Space，以它为底稿修改；按翻译键直接翻译选中内容。
- 提示词模式的追问弹窗和点选答案更可靠。
- Mac：Chrome、Edge 里也能贴回开始听写时的光标位置。
<!-- /typeleast-update -->

<!-- typeleast-update:en -->
- Mac: fn only dictates; ⌥Space opens Prompt mode.
- Mac: select text and press ⌥Space to revise it as a draft; the translate key translates the selection.
- Prompt mode's follow-up panel and one-click answers work reliably.
- Mac: in Chrome and Edge, text also goes where the cursor was when you started.
<!-- /typeleast-update -->
